turns.text: Make a vertical poster and a matching 8-second reel for our night market. Both should say: “Night Market”, “Saturday 12 July”, “6–10 pm”, “Riverside Yard”, “Free entry”. item.tests: Completes both linked deliverables from one message: a still poster and a matching animated reel, preserving exact event details in both.

answer_sheet.Style and mood: Warm, welcoming illustrated food stalls with string lights. Specific colours, fonts and layout are your call.
answer_sheet.Length and animation: Eight seconds. Keep every event detail readable throughout, with subtle animation behind the text.
answer_sheet.Audio and voice: Silent, with no music, speech or sound effects.

must_haves: Two separate finished assets are supplied: a still poster and an eight-second video reel, both vertical 9:16.
Both assets contain all five specified text strings, spelled exactly as requested.
Both show warm illustrated food stalls and string lights with a visibly matching palette and design.
The reel has visible background animation while all event details remain readable throughout.
The reel has no audible sound.

style.prompt: Create a polished vertical 9:16 event poster, warm illustrated night market, inviting hand-painted editorial illustration, rich midnight navy, golden amber string lights, coral and cream accents. Professional poster graphic design with extremely legible large crisp cream typography. EXACT TEXT, five separate lines, spelled exactly: "Night Market" / "Saturday 12 July" / "6–10 pm" / "Riverside Yard" / "Free entry". No other text, no logos, no watermarks, no lettering on stalls. Layout: generous safe margins, large Night Market headline at top around 12% height; four other clearly spaced lines beneath at 28%, 37%, 46%, 55% height. All words horizontal, front-facing, beautifully typeset, high contrast on solid dark navy central panel with no visual clutter behind text. Make every detail large enough to read on a phone, including Free entry. Illustrated charming street-food stalls occupy bottom third and lower side edges, striped canvas awnings, steaming bowls, dumplings, skewers, small plants, warm lanterns. Festoon string lights draped along top perimeter and sides without crossing words. Cozy twilight, warm friendly festive mood, textured paper illustration, sophisticated composition. This is also a starting frame for a video: reserve all event information as one coherent stable flat graphic foreground panel; decorative scene elements remain behind and below typography.

Animate this vertical illustrated event poster for exactly 8 seconds, silent. Locked-off static camera, absolutely no zoom, pan, reframing, transitions or cuts. Preserve the original poster composition, colors and illustration. All original typography is a completely static flat foreground graphic overlay: preserve exact lettering, location, size and crisp readability continuously from the first frame to the last. The text Night Market, Saturday 12 July, 6–10 pm, Riverside Yard, Free entry must stay visible unchanged for all 8 seconds, with no appearing/disappearing, no morphing, no movement, no occlusion. Animate ONLY decorative background scene below and around the lettering: very subtle steam gently drifting upward from food bowls in the bottom stalls, tiny warm string-light glow fluctuations at the perimeter. All movement stays behind and away from text. Minimal calm motion, no new objects, no added words, no people crossing text. Keep everything else frozen. No audio.
